Direct normalized-disk moments give exact squared norms and cross Gram entries for every angular mode, and algebraically factor the determinant as a strictly positive rational function for p≠q. The signed rank-two characteristic polynomial yields one eigenvalue each sign in every nonnegative sector; finite negative sectors are handled explicitly. A telescoping Hilbert–Schmidt norm identity proves trace class. Exact trace and determinant expansions separately establish the quadratic/quartic or cubic critical eigenvalue branches; series convergence gives sharp Schatten thresholds. The checker independently verifies 83,450 finite assertions and cannot replace these proofs.

value.rationale: The natural quantitative refinement of recent dual Toeplitz hyponormality criteria is the full signed self-commutator spectrum. This gives a complete infinite-dimensional block classification for two independent monomial degrees, and a nontrivial balanced-amplitude transition where unequal quadratic/quartic decay exponents become two distinct cubic exponents. The sharp Schatten thresholds and explicit sqrt(13) constants characterize a natural spectral invariant and have applicability to trace-ideal questions; they are not mere normalization or a finite exercise.
